text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. A period of 
intensive training for the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Furioso is about to start her final prep 
work right about now, too."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—It's almost time, isn't it? For our goal, 
the Japan Dirt Derby.
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is the final push!
Yeah, time for the final spurt!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. This training camp is right by the 
sea... It's a location reminiscent of 
Funabashi."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's treat this like Funabashi and get to 
running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we set off for a run, but—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's quite different, isn't it...? From 
the sea we're used to.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: When one thinks of the sea, naturally—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Concrete reclaimed land. Lined with 
warehouses, heavy-duty trailers driving 
by.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Compared to that, this place seems a bit 
too quaint, somehow...
choice_data_list:
Still, it can't be helped. Let's give it 
everything we've got in this run.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. This place has its own wonderful 
scenery, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after running plenty of laps—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. On this sandy beach, do you think 
maybe we could do "that"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Furioso and I began playing a game 
she often played at the Funabashi seaside. 
When—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Furioso-saaan, let's play, let's play♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, why are your hands on the sand? 
What are you doing? Did you drop a contact 
lens or something?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What the heck... Don't tell me you got 
into a fight with beach delinquents and 
they're makin' you grovel on your knees?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, who the hell are you bastards?! I'll 
make these punks yelp like kicked puppies!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it. What we're doing is—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Clam digging. It's clam digging.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Clam digging?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am gathering seashells. When it 
comes to essential beach activities, this 
is it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Lots of people do it in Funabashi. At 
Sanbanze, the mouth of the Edo River, and 
places like that.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I-Is that so... When I think of the 
beach, I usually picture beach volleyball 
or gravure shoots."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What's so interesting about that? The 
weather's so nice, and you've got your 
face glued to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"This in itself also serves as 
concentration training."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Trainer, let's dig. This is no 
time to be slacking off.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Sigh, you two really are a weird pair. 
Seriously...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even under Espoir City's exasperated gaze, 
Furioso and I enthusiastically dug for 
clams.
